goal.quote:

> $-\frac{1}{4}x - \frac{3}{2} \ge \frac{1}{8}x \xrightarrow{\text{(가)}} -2x - 12 \ge x \xrightarrow{\text{(나)}} -3x \ge 12 \xrightarrow{\text{(다)}} x \le -4$

> ㄷ. $a < b$이고 $c < 0$이면 $ac > bc$, $\frac{a}{c} > \frac{b}{c}$
